name: Review Jobber shops for OSHA preparation
goal: Read Jobber through the shared read-only connector and prepare a private candidate list for shops with 20 or more staff; do not message shops or change records.

config.prompt: Your step: connect the owner's Jobber test account using the shared connector setup instructions. Create no account or app from this flow; the connector reads only.

acceptance.cmd: python -c "from ventures.blocks.connectors import JobberClient; assert callable(JobberClient.get_jobs)"
